text:
About 8.5% of the world population, or roughly 650 million people, lived below $1.90 a day in 2019 according to World Bank estimates. The team note's 1.9 billion figure doesn't match this line; it's closer to the share below the higher $3.20 line, so it may be a different threshold. The exact percentage shifts slightly between World Bank releases and price-level revisions.

CONFIDENCE: 80
